# Draft:Michigan Notable Book Award

The Michigan Notable Book award is an annual literary award presented by the Library of Michigan for the most notable books written about Michigan, by Michigan residents, or about the Great Lakes. The program began as "Read Michigan" in 1991 and was changed to "Michigan Notable Books" in 2004. To be available for nomination, the book must have been published in the year prior to the award.
